title: Skill Marketplace
description: Overview of the shared skill registry: skills by board area, LOB, team and reach, with a searchable catalog and hints on duplicates and gaps.
insights: Skills are classified by board area (Finance, Sales, Marketing, Engineering), LOB (BTP, Concur, SuccessFactors), team and reach.
A skill starts as individual and is promoted step by step: team, LOB, board area, company.
Skills marked Sample are fictional and only illustrate the structure; registered skills come from the registry.
prompt: Bundled example: Skill Marketplace overview (static, data embedded by npm run sync:skill-marketplace).
